subject: CPPO go-live: entitlement mapping + invoice routing (next steps)
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>
To: CloudResell Ops <ops@cloudresell.com>, AWS Marketplace Partner Team <aws-partner@amazon.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 21 Aug 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: CPPO go-live: entitlement mapping + invoice routing (next steps)

Hi team —

Thanks again for partnering with us on the Channel Partner Private Offer for Acme Corp. As we prepare for the CPPO activation window the week of Aug 28, we need to align on two operational items that are currently blocking the go/no-go:

1) Entitlement SKU mapping: we need a confirmed mapping from the CPPO SKU IDs to the reseller entitlements (CloudResell subscriber IDs). I've attached our draft entitlement matrix (redwood-entitlement-matrix-v1.xlsx). Please review and add any missing mappings or corrections.

2) Invoice & PO routing: Acme's procurement requires invoices to be routed to finance@acme-corp.com and invoices must reference the PO number pattern ACME-2028-xxxx. We also need to confirm whether the reseller will re-invoice or whether billing will flow directly via the Marketplace settlement. Attached is a sample invoice for reference.

Action items I propose:
- CloudResell: confirm SKU -> entitlement mapping (reply inline in the attached matrix) by EOD Thu Aug 24
- AWS Partner Team: confirm whether Marketplace settlement will support the described invoice reference and PO pattern, or if reseller re-invoicing is required
- Ben / Karthik (internal): stand by for any follow-up evidence requests (SOC2 evidence, entity mapping)

If we can close these items by Aug 24, we can keep the Aug 28 activation slot. Otherwise we'll need to bump to the following week.

Thanks —
Dylan Brooks
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
D: +1 415-555-0193

Attachments: redwood-entitlement-matrix-v1.xlsx (spreadsheet), sample-invoice-acme.pdf (sample), reseller-agreement-docusign-link.txt (link)

From: CloudResell Ops <ops@cloudresell.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 21 Aug 2028 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: CPPO go-live: entitlement mapping + invoice routing (next steps)

Hi Dylan —

Appreciate the note. Quick questions after an initial pass through the entitlement matrix:

- A few SKUs (sku_5592, sku_5593) don't have a clear quantity cadence for Acme; are these metered or subscription SKUs?
- For invoice routing: CloudResell typically re-issues invoices to end-customers when we act as the reseller. If Acme needs invoices emitted by AWS Marketplace directly, we can support that only if the Marketplace settlement setup includes the required PO number metadata. Can you confirm whether Acme will accept Marketplace-generated invoices that contain the PO number in the invoice reference field?

Also, we tried the DocuSign link in the attachment and it redirected to an expired powerform. Please re-share the live reseller agreement link — we need it signed by our legal team prior to go-live.

We can tentatively commit to the Aug 28 slot if the SKU questions are resolved and we have a signed reseller agreement.

Cheers,
Maya Rao
Ops Lead, CloudResell Solutions
ops@cloudresell.com
+1 212-555-0187

Hi Maya —

Thanks for the quick review. Responses inline below and I've attached an updated matrix where I've marked the two contested SKUs as "metered" with sample ratecards.

- SKU cadence: sku_5592 and sku_5593 are metered (usage-based). I've added the expected billing granularity to the matrix (hourly usage buckets -> monthly invoice summary). If that doesn't map to CloudResell's entitlement model, let us know and we'll adapt.
- Invoice routing: Acme has confirmed they will accept Marketplace-generated invoices provided the PO number is reflected in the invoice reference line (they provided sample PO format: ACME-2028-####). Can AWS confirm whether the Marketplace settlement pipeline will persist that reference for downstream invoices?
- DocuSign: sorry about the expired link — new live powerform link is here: https://www.docusign.net/Member/PowerFormSigning.aspx?PowerFormId=abcd-1234 (added to related_links). We've also attached a plain-text link in reseller-agreement-docusign-link.txt for legal.

Ben / Karthik: filing a quick request for entity proof (W-9 / tax ID for CloudResell) and SOC2 snapshot for the resell relationship. Maya — can you provide a point-of-contact for finance and legal so we can expedite?

If we get a signed agreement and the SKU clarification by EOD Thu, Aug 24, we can confirm Aug 28 activation.

Best,
Dylan

Attachments: redwood-entitlement-matrix-v1.xlsx (updated), reseller-agreement-docusign-link.txt

From: AWS Marketplace Partner Team <aws-partner@amazon.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>, CloudResell Ops <ops@cloudresell.com>
Date: Thu, 23 Aug 2028 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: CPPO go-live: entitlement mapping + invoice routing (next steps)

Hi all —

Thanks for the updates. Confirming the following from Marketplace ops:

- Invoice reference: Marketplace settlement supports a free-form invoice reference field. As long as the PO number is passed as "invoiceReference" in the private offer payload, the resulting invoice will include that value. Please ensure the chargeback/PO integration includes ACME's PO pattern.
- Metered SKUs: Marketplace metered billing will generate an invoice summary monthly. Reseller re-invoicing is optional; CloudResell can choose to re-issue invoices to Acme. If CloudResell will re-issue, please confirm the billing entity and provide the tax ID for marketplace mapping.

We are good to keep the Aug 28 activation slot pending:
- CloudResell signs the reseller agreement via the DocuSign powerform (link provided)
- CloudResell provides tax ID and W-9 by EOD Thu Aug 24
- Dylan to confirm updated entitlement matrix with metered SKU flags (done)

Maya — please confirm who in your finance/legal team will sign and where we should expect the W-9 to be sent. Once we have that, Marketplace ops will finalize the private offer payload and enable the CPPO within 24 hours.

Regards,
Alyssa Chan
AWS Marketplace Partner Ops
aws-partner@amazon.com
